title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Trojanized Claude Code VS Code extension (v2.1.313) planted an SSH backdoor via Cursor's marketplace; clean 2.1.314 shipped Oct 30
bullets.summary: A malicious build of the anthropic.claude-code extension, disclosed Oct 29, reportedly reached up to ~5,000 Cursor users before Anthropic published a clean fix on Oct 30.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit any Claude Code extension installed on the AP Mac/Cursor (must be 2.1.314+), check ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, and pin extension sources. PRAGMA: supply-chain hygiene talking point for client agent tooling. Brand 9 Signs: low, but same Mac runs the order automation.

bullets.title: OpenAI Agents API adds Auto Review, async compaction, time awareness; Python SDK 3.42.0 adds context-compaction controls
bullets.summary: Oct 30–31 updates give long-running and scheduled agents configurable background/blocking context compaction, session review, and mid-session tool updates.
bullets.how: The Construct: compare against our own long-session context handling and scheduled-run patterns. PRAGMA: reference architecture for client long-running agents. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Anthropic usage policy reportedly bans unauthorized distillation/model scraping, effective Nov 12
bullets.summary: Reported Oct 31 via an X post (policy text not independently confirmed): outputs may not be used to train competing models without authorization.
bullets.how: The Construct: verify the policy text before Nov 12 and ensure no pipeline uses Claude outputs as training data for other models. PRAGMA: add to client contract/compliance checklist. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Anthropic research: Claude used as automated red-teamer against Anthropic's production misalignment monitor
bullets.summary: Claude-generated fine-tuning datasets evaded the monitor, showing automated search can find monitor blind spots (published ~Oct 31).
bullets.how: The Construct: adopt the pattern of using an agent to adversarially probe our own gates and verifiers. PRAGMA: sellable agent-QA/red-team service angle. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: &Truth emerges from stealth with $70M seed for formal verification of AI-generated code
bullets.summary: Builds a 'universal verification machine' to prove correctness of code written by AI agents (about Oct 29–30).
bullets.how: The Construct: signals that verification layers are where agent funding is going; track as a possible gate for generated code. PRAGMA: positioning for 'verified agent output' offerings. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent tooling is now an attack surface: a trojanized official extension shows the Construct must pin and verify every tool in the agent chain, and the strongest counter-trend (automated red-teaming, formal verification funding) is to treat verification of agent output as a first-class layer, not an afterthought.
